questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT a part of the target adopted by UNAIDS to end the AIDS epidemic?

options.label: A
options.text: 95% of people living with HIV know their status.

options.label: B
options.text: 95% of people living with HIV receive antiretroviral therapy (ART).

options.label: C
options.text: 95% of people receiving ART show decreased viral load.

options.label: D
options.text: 95% of people living with HIV have access to experimental treatments
